isis_nephthys_kneeling.label: Nephthys and Isis
isis_nephthys_kneeling.description: Two women kneel side by side, each with her name sign on her head: Nephthys (a basket on a house) and Isis (a throne).

goddess_over_scarab.label: The goddess over the scarab
goddess_over_scarab.description: A tall long-haired woman bends forward, one hand on the back of a figure lying face down with its head raised; a scarab beetle sits beneath her.
goddess_over_scarab.doubt: Layer named 'nut?'. Who she is (Nut?) and who lies under her hand is not certain.

god_enthroned.label: God on a throne
god_enthroned.description: A god sits on a block throne, wearing a tall crown with plumes and holding a was-sceptre.
god_enthroned.doubt: Probably Osiris (the crown), though he holds a was-sceptre, not crook and flail.

offering_stand.label: Offering stand
offering_stand.description: A tall offering stand with a round loaf on a dish and a lotus flower on top.

adorer_xi.label: Adorer
adorer_xi.description: A man in a long kilt stands facing left, both hands raised in praise.

anubis.label: Anubis
anubis.description: The jackal-headed god Anubis stands facing left, arms at his sides.

chest_bearer.label: Bearer of the chest
chest_bearer.description: A man in a long kilt carries a chest with a curved lid, holding it up on one raised hand.

isis_nephthys_standing_1.label: Nephthys and Isis
isis_nephthys_standing_1.description: Two women stand facing right, each raising a hand: Nephthys (a basket on a house on her head) and Isis (a throne), who holds an ankh.

baboons_praising_1.label: Two baboons
baboons_praising_1.description: Two baboons stand upright facing right, forepaws raised in praise toward the boat.

boat_of_ra.label: Ra's boat
boat_of_ra.description: A boat on the water. In the middle a god crouches wrapped in a cloak, a sun disc on horns on his head and a sceptre in his hand; before him a stand with a lotus flower; steering oars at the stern.

baboons_praising_2.label: Two baboons
baboons_praising_2.description: Two baboons stand upright facing left, forepaws raised in praise toward the boat.

isis_nephthys_standing_2.label: Isis and Nephthys
isis_nephthys_standing_2.description: Two women stand facing left, each raising one hand and holding an ankh: Isis (a throne on her head) and Nephthys (a basket on a house).

baboons_seated_x.label: Two seated baboons
baboons_seated_x.description: Two baboons squat on their haunches facing right, hands on their knees.

boat_of_khepri.label: Khepri's boat
boat_of_khepri.description: A boat on the water carries a crouching god with a scarab beetle for a head and wide horns; a stand with a lotus flower before him, and a damaged sign at the prow.
boat_of_khepri.doubt: The sign at the prow is broken and could not be made out.

inscriptions_ix.label: Inscriptions
inscriptions_ix.description: The hieroglyphic text above the scenes of plate IX, with remnants of signs.

kneeling_adorer.label: Kneeling adorer
kneeling_adorer.description: A man kneels on his heels facing left, both hands raised in praise toward the boat.

baboons_seated_ix.label: Two seated baboons
baboons_seated_ix.description: Two baboons squat on their haunches facing left, hands on their knees.
baboons_seated_ix.doubt: Read as baboons (they match the seated baboons of plate X); the heads could also be read as lions'.

falcon_standard.label: Falcon on a standard
falcon_standard.description: A falcon with a flail at its back perches on a tall standard.

cat_and_snake.label: The cat and the snake
cat_and_snake.description: A long-eared cat sits upright and holds down the head of a long wavy snake with its paw: Ra as the great cat of Heliopolis, cutting up Apep.

persea_tree.label: Persea tree
persea_tree.description: A tall leafy tree beside the cat: the persea tree of Heliopolis.

small_seated_god.label: Small seated figure
small_seated_god.description: A small figure sits on the ground with one knee drawn up.
small_seated_god.doubt: Badly drawn or damaged; the head may be a falcon's.

two_seated_gods.label: Two seated gods
two_seated_gods.description: Two gods with long wigs and beards sit on block thrones, facing right.

two_bowls.label: Two bowls
two_bowls.description: Two ribbed bowls side by side, with signs set on and above them: a jar, a stand, a loaf and a long rope-like sign, under a band of water ripples and a domed sign.

god_with_two_eyes.label: God beneath two eyes
god_with_two_eyes.description: A wrapped, bearded god stands facing left beneath a pair of wedjat eyes.

god_with_emblem.label: God with a sign on his head
god_with_emblem.description: A bearded god stands facing left, a tall curled sign on his head.
god_with_emblem.doubt: The sign on his head could not be identified.

duamutef.label: Duamutef
duamutef.description: A mummy-shaped figure with a jackal's head, facing right: Duamutef, a son of Horus.

imsety.label: Imsety
imsety.description: A mummy-shaped figure with a human head in a heavy wig, facing right: Imsety, a son of Horus.
imsety.doubt: The face is mostly lost; human by elimination (the other three heads are jackal, baboon and falcon).

shrine_with_falcon.label: Tall shrine
shrine_with_falcon.description: A tall shrine with ribbed sides and a vaulted roof, a falcon perched on top, between the sons of Horus.

hapy.label: Hapy
hapy.description: A mummy-shaped figure with a baboon's head, facing left: Hapy, a son of Horus.

qebehsenuef.label: Qebehsenuef
qebehsenuef.description: A mummy-shaped figure with a falcon's head, facing left: Qebehsenuef, a son of Horus.

cow_on_shrine.label: The cow on the shrine
cow_on_shrine.description: A cow lies on a shrine, a sun disc with two plumes on her head and a flail on her back: Mehet-weret, the great cow of the sky.
cow_on_shrine.doubt: Layer named 'Ram shrine'; the crown sits on wavy ram-like horns, but the body is a cow's.

inscriptions_viii.label: Inscriptions
inscriptions_viii.description: The hieroglyphic text above the scenes of plate VIII, with remnants of signs.

adorer_with_bowl.label: Adorer with a bowl
adorer_with_bowl.description: A man stands facing left, one hand raised in praise, the other holding up a small bowl.

wedjat_shrine.label: Eye on a shrine
wedjat_shrine.description: The wedjat eye, the Eye of Horus, rests on a shrine.

seated_god_snout.label: Seated figure
seated_god_snout.description: A figure sits with one knee drawn up; it has an animal's head with a snout, in a heavy wig.
seated_god_snout.doubt: The animal is unclear (a dog or a baboon?).

snake_shrine.label: Shrine with a snake
snake_shrine.description: A tall shrine with a rearing snake inside and three blades standing on its roof.

mourning_women.label: Two mourning women
mourning_women.description: Two women kneel facing left, each with a hand at her face in mourning; small signs lie on the ground before them.

nephthys_kite.label: Nephthys as a kite
nephthys_kite.description: A kite with the Nephthys sign (a basket on a house) on its head, at the head of the bier: Nephthys mourning the dead.

mummy_on_bier.label: The mummy on the bier
mummy_on_bier.description: The mummy lies on a lion-shaped bier, the lion's head at one end and its tail curling up at the other; four looped signs below.

isis_kite.label: Isis as a kite
isis_kite.description: A kite with the Isis sign (a throne) on its head stands on a low base at the foot of the bier: Isis mourning the dead.

benu_heron.label: Benu heron
benu_heron.description: A crested heron facing left: the Benu, the bird of renewal.
benu_heron.doubt: A sliver of the Isis kite's tail is in this layer at its left edge.

lion_left.group: Lions and solar procession/Lions and sun
lion_left.label: Lion (left)
lion_left.description: A lion sits upright facing left, back to back with the other across the horizon: Aker, yesterday and tomorrow.

horizon.group: Lions and solar procession/Lions and sun
horizon.label: The horizon
horizon.description: The horizon sign: the sun disc rising between two hills, between the two lions.

inscriptions_vii.label: Inscriptions
inscriptions_vii.description: The hieroglyphic text above the scenes of plate VII, with remnants of signs.

lion_right.group: Lions and solar procession/Lions and sun
lion_right.label: Lion (right)
lion_right.description: A lion sits upright facing right, back to back with the other across the horizon: Aker, yesterday and tomorrow.

boat_with_crew.label: Boat with a crew of gods
boat_with_crew.description: A long boat on the water with six gods standing in it holding spears, three on each side of a stand where a crowned animal lies under a sun disc.
boat_with_crew.doubt: The animal on the stand could not be identified.

man_with_flowers.label: Man with flowers
man_with_flowers.description: A man holds up a lotus flower in one hand and a bunch of flowers in the other; a tall pointed pole stands beside him.
man_with_flowers.doubt: What the pointed pole is could not be made out.

adorer_vii.label: Adorer
adorer_vii.description: A man stands facing left, both hands raised in praise.

ba_bird.label: The ba
ba_bird.description: A bird with a human head, a long wig and a curled beard stands on a low base: the ba, the soul of the dead.
ba_bird.doubt: Layer named 'Walking woman'. The branch-like thing held before it is unclear.

falcon_on_perch.label: Falcon on a perch
falcon_on_perch.description: A falcon stands on a perch with a curved rest.

senet_booth.label: The booth
senet_booth.description: Under a canopy the deceased sits on a chair, a staff in hand, before a game board on a stand: playing senet, the game that decides the passage.

deceased_standing.label: The deceased
deceased_standing.description: A man in a long robe with a sash stands facing left, a staff in his hand: the deceased.
deceased_standing.doubt: Layer named 'Standing deity', but he is a man, not a god.
